text.tspan: 1. USB-C is for flashing and debugging through the ESP32-C6 built-in USB-Serial-JTAG. It is inside the box, not used in the field.
2. D4 lets the board run from USB on the bench (relay coil and RF receiver work at ~4.6 V). R8/R9 make the port a USB device (sink).
3. J2 is an alternative UART flashing port (needs a 3.3 V USB-UART adapter). Hold SETUP/BOOT while resetting to enter download mode.
